text:
maria: Quick heads-up: prepping internal RN + ops announce for rwd-infer@v2.4.0. Proposed change window: 2026-03-27 03:30-04:30 UTC. Need pin and deploybot window.

maria: Draft RN (short):
```
v2.4.0 - Serving runtime and infra tweaks
- Faster KV-cache resume for hot clients
- Reduced p99 tail latency for long-contexts (~15% median improvement)
- New opt-in limit: `max_tokens_per_request` (helps mem-heavy tenants)
- DB: online, throttled schema migration for model_meta.indexes (per-shard)
```

maria: Proposed rollback triggers: >=1% 5xx across prod OR p99 latency >1.8x baseline OR QA eval drift >4%. Owners: @kevin oncall, @sara infra, @jessie comms.

kevin: I'll be oncall for the window. Request: make the canary 5% for 20m and capture full p95/p99 traces. If p99 >1.8x I'll flip the fallback route to v2.3.x and start rollback.

sara: Infra checklist: confirm per-shard throttling for schema migration, verify disk headroom on index nodes, bump autoscaler burst limit to handle migration spikes. I'll run smoke at 03:00 UTC.

jessie: Comms note: internal announce should say "no expected customer downtime; dedicated customers pinned remain on their versions" and include quick rollback steps + dashboard link.

lina: Pin added in console: rwd-infer@v2.4.0. Scheduling internal blast for 03:10 UTC (20m before deploy).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-03-27 03:35 UTC (5% traffic, 20m) -> roll to 50% at 03:58 UTC if canary passes -> full rollout 04:12 UTC. CLI: `deploybot release --env prod --version rwd-infer@v2.4.0 --canary 5% --duration 20m`.

maria: Added final internal snippet (ready to publish):
```
Internal: Rolling rollout of rwd-infer@v2.4.0 on 2026-03-27 03:30-04:30 UTC. No expected customer downtime. DB migration: online throttled schema migration on model_meta.indexes (per-shard). Rollback triggers: >=1% 5xx, p99 latency >1.8x baseline, QA drift >4%. Owners: @kevin oncall, @sara infra, @jessie comms. Deploybot: `deploybot release --env prod --version rwd-infer@v2.4.0 --canary 5% --duration 20m`. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/v2-4-release
```

kevin: Dashboard link good. I'll set oncall reminders at 03:20 and 03:35 UTC.

sara: Smoke run scheduled 03:00 UTC. Will post results here.

jessie: I'll send the internal blast at 03:10 UTC, with a short rollback playbook and owner tags.

maria: Thanks team. If no objections I'll lock RN in 8m and mark thread ops-ready. :thumbsup:
